title: Vanilla Expanse
description: A new vanilla-style modpack with another experiment! Carefully optimized so everyone can experience the new world. "I think vanilla is too boring, so I fixed it..."
body:
# Vanilla Expanse **Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge** _A new vanilla style modpack with another experient_ ![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cd8a025440f35bf6a9363abde93a86f4ceec3ef_0.webp) ## See the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vanilla-expanse/gallery) > ⭐ 275+ Mods for Enhanced Gameplay > > ⭐ Completely Overhauled World Generation with 150+ New Biomes > > ⭐ Fully Optimized with Shader Support > > ⭐ Overhauled Strongholds, Dungeons & Mineshafts > > ⭐ 500+ of NEW Structures Including Flying Airships & Underground Cities > > ⭐ 5+ New Bosses and 400+ Mobs with Unique Mechanics > > ⭐ 5 Dimensions to Explore > > ⭐ Cooking System with Status Effects > > ⭐ Survival Mechanics: Temperature, Thirst & Seasons --- ## What This Pack Adds ### Automation Build complex mechanical systems.
Details - **Conveyor belt networks** and rotating gears - Steam engines and train transport - Multi-stage **processing** (crushing, washing, smelting) - **Automated farming** with mechanical planters and harvesters - **Liquid pipelines** and storage systems - Decorative industrial **building blocks**
### World Generation Dozens of new biomes and new views.
Details - Cherry blossom forests, lavender fields, tropical islands, red rock canyons - **Natural tree growth** with realistic branching and physics - Overhauled **dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds, and temples** - Flying **airships and sprawling underground cities** - Additional **towers, ruins, and villages**
### Creatures 400+ new animals and fantasy beings
Details - Real **wildlife**: grizzly bears, roadrunners, orcas, elephants, deer - **Fantasy** creatures: ender minions, bone serpents, mystical beings - Small **companions**: otters, red pandas, hummingbirds - **Undead variants** with unique mechanics - Diverse **enderman and creeper types** - Challenging **bosses** with unique attack patterns
### Cooking Expanded culinary system with meaningful mechanics
Details - New crops: **tomatoes, rice, cabbage, and more** - **Cooking pot system** requiring heat sources - Meals providing **status effects** (regeneration, absorption, etc.) - Baking: **bread, pastries, and desserts** - Brewing: **alcoholic beverages and drinks** - **Cross-dimensional** ingredients from Nether and End - Kitchen **automation integration**
### Exploration Adventure content throughout all dimensions
Details - _500+_ of **new structures** to discover - Equippable **artifacts** granting unique abilities - Fast **travel network** via craftable waystones - **Enhanced loot** in chests throughout the world
### Survival Mechanics Environmental challenges for deeper gameplay
Details - **Temperature management** requiring appropriate clothing and shelter - **Hydration mechanics** requiring water sources - Enhanced **mob AI** for smarter enemies
--- ## Performance ### Need **7-8.5GB** of memory
